label: SPI 2022 coordinate geometry, parallelogram PQRS
reason: fix: stem copy error, P(l, 2) is P(1, 2) (the only reading the key and options fit); owner approved 2026-10-30
text: If P(1, 2), Q(4, 6), R(5, 7) and S(a, b) are the vertices of a parallelogram PQRS, then
solution:
The diagonals PR and QS of a parallelogram bisect each other, so P + R = Q + S.

\(1 + 5 = 4 + a\) gives a = 2; \(2 + 7 = 6 + b\) gives b = 3.

Check: PQ goes (+3, +4) and SR goes from (2, 3) to (5, 7), also (+3, +4).
